## Summary

Resume Ranker is a tool that compares a resume to a job description and returns a section-by-section match analysis. These terms describe the rules for using the service and the limits of our responsibility. Plain English; please read them. By signing in, you agree to all of what follows.

## Acceptance of these terms

When you check the "I agree" box on the sign-in page and submit your email, you accept these terms and our Privacy Policy. We record which version you accepted and when. If you don't agree to these terms, do not sign in.

## The service

Resume Ranker accepts a resume and a job description, then produces a section-by-section analysis with evidence quotes from both documents. The service is provided "as is" without any warranty (see Disclaimers below). We may pause, change, or discontinue the service at any time.

## Eligibility

You must be at least 13 years old (or the minimum digital-consent age in your jurisdiction, whichever is higher) to use Resume Ranker. You must have the legal capacity to enter into a binding agreement. If you're using the service on behalf of an organization, you confirm you have authority to bind that organization to these terms.

## Acceptable use

When using Resume Ranker, you agree NOT to:
- Submit content you don't own or have permission to upload.
- Use the service to harass, defame, or violate the rights of any third party.
- Attempt to access accounts, data, or features that are not yours.
- Scrape, crawl, or use automated systems to interact with the service.
- Reverse-engineer, decompile, or attempt to derive source code.
- Use the service to build a competing product or train models.
- Interfere with the service's normal operation.

## Your content

You retain ownership of everything you upload — your resume text, the job description, and any analyses you generate.

You grant us a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to process your content solely for the purpose of providing you the analysis. Under our **Zero-Retention Policy**, your documents are not stored after processing. Furthermore, under our **Zero-Training Policy**, we explicitly prohibit the use of your content to train, fine-tune, or improve any machine-learning models. We act strictly as a **Data Processor**, and we do not sell, rent, or share your content with third parties.

## AI output disclaimer

Resume Ranker uses a large language model to generate the analysis. Output from any large language model can be inaccurate, incomplete, out of date, biased, or otherwise unsuitable for your purpose. You should treat the analysis as a starting point for your own thinking, not as authoritative advice.

## Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. If we make material changes, we will update the version date at the top of this page and we will notify you via email. Continuing to use the service after such an email means you accept the updated terms.

## Contact

For questions about these terms or to make a request that can't be handled through the in-app controls, use our contact form.

## Information we collect

- **Account data:** To use the service, you must provide an email address. We store a cryptographic hash of your password. We don't see the password itself.
- **Your content:** We temporarily process the resumes (PDF text extraction) and job descriptions you submit in order to generate the analysis.
- **Log data:** We automatically record basic request metadata (like IP address, browser type, and timestamp) for security and debugging purposes.

## How we use your information

Your email is used solely to identify your account, send you password reset links, and notify you if these legal terms change.

The documents you upload are passed to our analysis engine to generate the results. In our capacity as a **Data Processor**, we strictly enforce a **Zero-Training Policy**: your data is never used to train, fine-tune, or improve any artificial intelligence or machine learning models.

## How long we keep it

We strictly enforce a **Zero-Retention Policy**. We do not permanently store your resumes or job descriptions. They are kept in active memory only long enough to perform the extraction and generate the analysis. Once the analysis is returned to you, the source documents are instantly discarded.

Your account data (email, password hash, and agreement records) is kept until you delete your account.

## Your rights

Depending on where you live (e.g., under GDPR or CCPA), you may have the right to:
- Access the personal data we hold about you.
- Request correction of inaccurate data.
- Request deletion of your account and data.

You can manage or delete your account directly from your dashboard settings.
